{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify the 6 QA rows with revenue = 999999.99
qa_rows = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Check their distribution across channels and conversion status
print('QA rows channel distribution:')
print(qa_rows['channel'].value_counts())
print('\nQA rows converted status:')
print(qa_rows['converted'].value_counts())

# Remove QA rows from the dataset
df_clean = df[~(df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)].copy()

# Now compute conversion rate by channel on the cleaned dataset
conv_rate = df_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum']).reset_index()
conv_rate['conversion_rate'] = conv_rate['sum'] / conv_rate['count']

# Extract email and paid_search conversion rates
email_rate = conv_rate[conv_rate['channel'] == 'email']['conversion_rate'].iloc[0]
paid_search_rate = conv_rate[conv_rate['channel'] == 'paid_search']['conversion_rate'].iloc[0]

# Compute difference: email - paid_search
diff = email_rate - paid_search_rate

# Print final results
print(f'Email conversion rate: {email_rate:.4f}')
print(f'Paid search conversion rate: {paid_search_rate:.4f}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search): {diff:.4f}')"}
